title: Logo generator from description with animated preview

requirements.text: Create a single-page UI where a user can enter a company logo description (free-text) and trigger logo generation, showing loading/error states and the resulting static logo preview.

quotes: Create an app that designs a logo for my company based on a description

acceptanceCriteria: The page contains a multiline text input labeled in English (e.g., "Describe your company and the vibe of the logo") and a primary action to generate a logo.
When generation is running, the UI shows a clear loading state and prevents duplicate submissions.
If generation fails, an English error message is shown with an option to retry.
After success, a static logo preview is displayed without requiring a page refresh.

requirements.text: Implement a deterministic, offline logo-design generator that converts the user-provided description into a structured logo specification and renders a clean vector logo (SVG) from it (no external AI/LLM or third-party APIs).

quotes: designs a logo for my company based on a description

acceptanceCriteria: Given the same description, the generated logo output is the same across runs (deterministic).
Logo generation does not call any external services; it runs fully in the frontend.
The generator produces an SVG logo that includes at least: a mark (icon/shape) + a wordmark text element derived from the description (e.g., extracted/guessed company name or first meaningful words).
The SVG scales crisply at different sizes (e.g., small preview and larger preview) without raster artifacts.

requirements.text: Show an animated version of the generated logo, with user controls to play/pause and adjust animation speed; the animation should be derived from the same logo specification and remain visually consistent with the static logo.

quotes: then shows me an animated version.

acceptanceCriteria: An "Animated preview" area is shown after a logo is generated.
The animation can be played/paused via a control in the UI.
A speed control (e.g., slider) changes the animation timing in real time.
The animated logo uses the same colors/shapes/typography as the static SVG (no unrelated second design).

requirements.text: Persist generated logo projects per signed-in user: store the description, generated logo specification, and timestamps; provide a list to reopen previously generated logos.

quotes: Create an app that designs a logo for my company based on a description

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated, generating a logo saves a new project record in the backend.
The UI shows a "My logos" list for the signed-in user, displaying at least description snippet and creation time.
Selecting an item from the list restores the static and animated previews for that project.
Data returned for a user only includes that user’s saved projects.

requirements.text: Add export options to download the generated logo as SVG and a raster image (PNG) from the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: After generation, the UI provides a download action for SVG.
After generation, the UI provides a download action for PNG at a reasonable default size (e.g., 1024x1024) rendered from the SVG client-side.
Downloaded files open correctly in common viewers/editors (SVG in browser/vector editor; PNG in image viewer).

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme for the app UI (colors, typography, layout) with a distinct style suitable for a creative design tool, and use it consistently across all screens and states.
acceptanceCriteria: The app uses a consistent color palette, typography scale, and spacing system across input, buttons, panels, previews, and lists.
The theme is clearly creative-tool oriented (e.g., light canvas background, subtle grid/texture, bold accent color) and does not rely on default unstyled components.
All user-facing text is in English.

constraints: Do not use external AI/LLM services or third-party logo-generation APIs; generation must be implemented within the app.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files in frontend immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead).
nonGoals: Advanced professional logo editing tools (layers, bezier editing, full typography controls).
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.

required: Abstract creative-tool background pattern, subtle grid with soft shapes (app-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Minimal monochrome app icon featuring a geometric mark (app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
